# tidy_imports

> A Dart CLI, installed as a dev dependency, that sorts and groups the import directives of a Dart or Flutter project: Dart, Flutter, package and project imports, each under a label. Its default output is the same as import_sorter's, whose spiritual successor it is. It writes the blank line `dart format` 3.13+ writes, has an option for each import lint (`directives_ordering`, `prefer_relative_imports`, `always_use_package_imports`), fails CI on unsorted files, and can report import cycles, dead files and coupling. Dart SDK 3.0 or later.

Install with `dart pub add dev:tidy_imports` (or `flutter pub add dev:tidy_imports`) and run `dart run tidy_imports` from the folder that holds `pubspec.yaml`. Useful commands:

- `dart run tidy_imports --dry-run`: show what would change, write nothing
- `dart run tidy_imports --exit-if-changed`: CI check; names every unsorted file and exits 1
- `dart run tidy_imports --flat --sort-exports`: the order the `directives_ordering` lint wants
- `dart run tidy_imports --doctor` (`--apply`): check the configuration against `analysis_options.yaml` (and write the fixes)
- `dart run tidy_imports --report`: import cycles, dead files, unused or dev-only dependencies, coupling; `--format=mermaid|dot|json`

Every option is also a key in a `tidy_imports:` block of `pubspec.yaml` or in a standalone `tidy_imports.yaml`. Deleting anything (duplicate or unused imports) and sorting `pubspec.yaml` are opt-in.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Franklyn-R-Silva/tidy_imports/main/README.md): The tour: install, before and after, lints, import graph, CI, FAQ
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Franklyn-R-Silva/tidy_imports/main/docs/getting-started.md): Installing, running, choosing files, directories scanned, monorepos, defaults
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Franklyn-R-Silva/tidy_imports/main/docs/configuration.md): Every flag and config key, the standalone file, config diagnostics
- [Agreeing with your lints](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Franklyn-R-Silva/tidy_imports/main/docs/lint-agreement.md): `--doctor`, `--flat`, `--relative-imports`, `--package-imports`, `dart format` 3.13+
- [CI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Franklyn-R-Silva/tidy_imports/main/docs/ci.md): GitHub Actions, exit codes, pre-commit hooks
- [Coming from import_sorter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Franklyn-R-Silva/tidy_imports/main/docs/migrating-from-import_sorter.md): How to switch, and what changed
- [Shaping the output](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Franklyn-R-Silva/tidy_imports/main/docs/output-shape.md): Groups, custom tiers, exports, folder grouping, test doubles
- [Cleaning up](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Franklyn-R-Silva/tidy_imports/main/docs/cleanup.md): Duplicate imports, unused imports, sorting `pubspec.yaml`
- [The import graph](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Franklyn-R-Silva/tidy_imports/main/docs/import-graph.md): `--report` findings and the Mermaid, DOT and JSON output
- [Tricky imports](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Franklyn-R-Silva/tidy_imports/main/docs/tricky-imports.md): Multi-line, conditional and commented directives
